bullets.title: AVGO: AI Revenue to Double to $115B in FY27, $230B in FY28; Street Raises PTs
bullets.body: Broadcom beat F3Q26 with AI semi revenue of $16.7B (+221% y/y), guided F4Q to $21.7B, and raised FY27 AI revenue to $115B from $100B, with FY28 expected to double again to ~$230B and $30+ EPS. Anthropic becomes largest XPU customer in FY27 (5GW → 10GW FY28), OpenAI deploying 1.3GW in FY27 (>5GW FY28); Google relationship 'never stronger' via take-or-pay LTA. Key PTs: GS $540, Citi $515 (Buy), UBS $470 (Buy), Wolfe $500 (OW), KeyBanc $575 (OW); Macquarie upgraded to Outperform ($490). Stock -3.6% on some buyside disappointment with FY27 guide vs. $130-150B bogey, but FY28 de-risks the multi-year outlook; trades at ~12x FY28 EPS vs. 5-yr avg 21x.

bullets.title: SNOW: +23.6% Premarket on Best Software Print of Cycle; AI Flywheel Accelerating
bullets.body: Snowflake delivered F2Q27 product revenue of $1.492B (+37% y/y, beat by ~5%), the third consecutive quarter of acceleration, with AI products (Cortex Code at 9,100+ accounts, CoWork at 5,800) contributing ~half the acceleration. F3Q guide of $1.588-1.593B (+37-38% y/y) beat consensus by ~$80M; FY27 product revenue guide raised to $6.07B (+36% y/y). NRR stable at 126%; cRPO +40% y/y. PTs raised across the board: UBS $500 (Buy), Citi $490 (Buy), Wolfe $500 (OW), KeyBanc $460 (OW), Oppenheimer $475, Mizuho $425, JPM $426 (OW), Piper $450 (OW). Stock +23.6% premarket.

bullets.title: HPE: Beat/Raise but -4.6% on Elevated Expectations; FY27 Guide to 13-17% Revenue Growth
bullets.body: HPE reported F3Q26 revenue of $12.21B (+34% y/y) and EPS $1.11 vs. $0.93 consensus; Cloud & AI revenue $9.04B beat by ~5%; orders +42% y/y. FY27 revenue guidance raised to 13-17% (vs. 8-12% prior) with EPS $4.40-4.60 (+16-20%); FCF raised to $5B+. Post-quarter signed $3.5B hyperscale on-prem inferencing deal; Oracle multi-gigawatt switching deployment adding to FY27 pipeline. Stock -4.6% premarket on networking miss vs. peers and elevated investor bar. Citi raises PT to $76 (Buy); JPM reiterates OW, $70 PT; MS new PT $67.

bullets.title: NVDA: Acquiring Hugging Face for $12.9B Including $1B Retention Package
bullets.body: NVIDIA confirmed a definitive agreement to acquire Hugging Face for ~$11.9B payable to stockholders plus up to $1.0B in equity-based retention for employees joining NVIDIA. Deal expected to close H1 2027. Hugging Face operates the leading open-source AI platform for developing, sharing, and deploying models, datasets, and applications.

bullets.title: CIEN: Strong Q3 Beat; GM 46.4% (+150bps); FY Guidance Raised to $6.42B
bullets.body: Ciena reported Q3 EPS $2.11 vs. $1.73 consensus and revenue $1.67B vs. $1.64B; non-GAAP gross margin 46.4% beat Street by 150bps (vs. 41.9% year-ago). Q4 revenue guided $1.75B ±$50M above $1.70B consensus; FY2026 guidance raised to $6.42B ±$50M. JPM noted strong GM beat and LTA positioning to take share from Nokia; stock up ~4% premarket. Concentration risk: two customers at 41.7% of Q3 revenue.

bullets.title: DELL: Upgraded to Outperform; AI Momentum Drives Record Backlog
bullets.body: DELL was upgraded to Outperform at Fox Advisors (PT $625) following record orders of $60B and $95B backlog. Retail data shows DELL surged ~16% post-earnings on AI momentum and durable IT refresh. Traditional server share gain of 10+ points over two quarters; AI server margins in mid-single digits through platform transitions. Storage mix shift to Dell IP driving margin upside. Supply (DRAM, NAND, CPU) remains the only demand constraint.

bullets.title: MSFT: Segment Restructure to Two-Segment Format; Azure Guide Tweaked to 44-45%
bullets.body: Microsoft restructured reporting into 'Agents and Infrastructure' and 'Devices and Consumer' segments; Azure becomes a pure consumption/AI infrastructure KPI after removing GitHub, Security Copilot, and Healthcare Cloud. Azure FQ1 guide slightly trimmed to 44-45% cc (from ~45%); M365 Cloud raised to +17% y/y (from +15%). Citi maintains Buy, $600 PT (26x FY28 EPS); KeyBanc reiterates OW, $600 PT. Restructure viewed as confidence signal — greater transparency vs. AWS/GCP.

bullets.title: MDB: Q2 +30.5% Revenue Beat; Sells Off on H2 Guide Optics Despite Atlas Durability
bullets.body: MongoDB beat Q2 with revenue $771.8M (+30.5% y/y, $40M beat); Atlas +28.9% y/y for fifth consecutive quarter near 29%; non-GAAP operating margin expanded 940bps to 24.1%. FY27 guide raised $70M to $2,990-3,030M. Stock sold off on H2 Atlas guide of ~26% (vs. street run-rate ~29%) and positioning — Hedgeye maintains Active Long, modeling ~29% Atlas Q3 and ~30.4% Q4. ~30% of Atlas ARR from AI use cases; Voyage customer base roughly doubled QoQ.

bullets.title: CRWD: Fal.Con Raises $10B/$20B ARR Targets by One Year; FY28 NNARR Guide 20%+
bullets.body: CrowdStrike at Fal.Con 2026 raised FY28 net new ARR growth guidance to 20%+ (vs. ~11% consensus) and accelerated $10B ARR milestone to FY30 (from FY31) and $20B to FY35 (from FY36). Launched SafeMind (security-specific AI models) and Falcon Guardion (agent lifecycle management). FY28 FCF margin target 32.5%. Piper reiterates OW; Mizuho reiterates Outperform, $250 PT; Wolfe Outperform, $230 PT; D.A. Davidson Buy $245 PT.

bullets.title: WMG: Morgan Stanley Elevates to Top Pick; Catalog Worth $22-42/Share, $36 PT
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley raises WMG (Warner Music Group — traded as WBD in note) to Top Pick with $36 PT (30% upside); catalog assets alone represent $22-42/share (~$32 midpoint) or ~90% of equity value. FY26 YTD revenue/EBITDA growth +12%/+25%; stock trades at ~10x forward EBITDA despite 10-11% CAGR thesis. Bull case $42 with AI tailwinds; bear case $23. AI concerns viewed as overblown.

bullets.title: GOOGL: AdTech Antitrust — Structural Divestitures Rejected; Behavioral Remedies Ordered
bullets.body: Federal judge rejected DOJ's proposed structural remedies (AdX/DFP divestiture) against Google, ordering behavioral remedies instead including no AdWords tying, equal AdX access for rival publishers, deprecation of Unified Pricing Rules, and prohibition of first/last look bidding. KeyBanc views outcome as near-term positive for SSPs (PubMatic), neutral for demand-side (TTD), and no material revenue impact for Alphabet given AdTech is a minor revenue stream.

bullets.title: DKNG: July OSB GGR +34% y/y; Share Up 2pts to 28%; World Cup Adds ~$5.5B Handle
bullets.body: Total digital gaming GGR rose 25% y/y to $2.3B in July; OSB GGR +34% y/y to $1.29B driven by World Cup with an estimated $5.5B total handle lift (~3% FY26 boost). DraftKings OSB share rose 2pts m/m to 34% (vs. FanDuel 35%). August MTD handle tracking +10-23% in key states despite soft sports calendar. Promotional spend +23% y/y but aligned with handle growth; intensity stable.

bullets.title: CRM: AI Workforce Data — Salesforce Postings +51% y/y; Cited by 73% of AI-Natives
bullets.body: Zukin's AI Workforce data shows Salesforce job postings surging 51% y/y to 1,488 roles (#3 in panel behind Oracle and Microsoft), cited by 73% of 95 AI-native companies — fastest-growing non-hyperscaler for AI-native citations. ServiceNow postings fell 37% y/y, continuing multi-quarter decline. All-SaaS index trades at 5.9x FY+2 EV/Sales, underperforming S&P 500 (IGV +3.6% YTD vs. S&P +13.4%).

bullets.title: META: Launches Muse Spark 1.3 AI Model; AVGO On Track with 3GW MTIA Deployment
bullets.body: Meta launched Muse Spark 1.3 with paid developer API access, claiming performance nearing top rivals and operating 25% more efficiently (fewer tokens). Separately, Broadcom confirmed its MTIA XPU partnership with Meta remains on track — three generations delivered by YE27 with line of sight to 3GW deployment through FY28; Q4 production shipments expected for inference/recommendation-optimized MTIA.

bullets.title: AAPL: App Store Revenue -1% in August on FX-Neutral Basis; Gaming Weakness Persists
bullets.body: UBS and Roth both flag Apple App Store revenue declined ~1% on an FX-neutral basis in August, driven by weakness in gaming revenue with slowdowns in US and rest-of-world markets. No rating change.

bullets.title: OMC: Loses $1.7B PepsiCo Global Media Account to Publicis
bullets.body: Omnicom lost the $1.7B PepsiCo global media account to Publicis Groupe. The win could add ~50bps to Publicis organic growth in 2027. Meaningful negative for OMC revenue base.

bullets.title: ETSY: Roth QSG Proprietary Shopper/Seller Survey Now Available
bullets.body: Roth QSG finalized Volume 31 of its proprietary Etsy shopper and seller survey covering awareness, penetration, experience, future intentions, and seller profiles. Available at $5,000 standard or $3,500 trial rate — signal on consumer e-commerce trends for ETSY positioning.

bullets.title: GOOGL/AMZN/MSFT: Jefferies $26T AI TAM Deep Dive; Top Picks Include ORCL, CRWD, SNOW, INTU
bullets.body: Jefferies sizes AI TAM at $26T with fastest monetization ramp in history, noting median US business spends only $12/employee/month on AI vs. $777 for software. Top large-cap picks: MSFT, AMZN, GOOGL for scaled platforms; ORCL and CRWV for constrained compute; CRWD and SNOW for security/data; INTU as contrarian given 40-year data and sticky apps. Infrastructure bottlenecks (power, people, permits) will slow near-term but reinforce long runway.

bullets.title: ChatGPT Ads Hit $1B ARR in 200 Days; Pinterest, GOOGL Most Exposed
bullets.body: ChatGPT Ads scaled from zero to $1B ARR in 200 days (Feb-Aug 2026), growing from ~600 to >10,000 advertisers. Roth sees $5B ARR achievable in next 200 days. Competes directly for search and commerce budgets — Google Search is the closest analog. Pinterest cited as most exposed among scaled platforms, followed by Google and Reddit.

bullets.title: CVNA: Morgan Stanley Top Pick; FCF Generation and EBITDA/Unit Flywheel Underappreciated
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley raises CVNA PT to $90 on strong execution of share gains and EBITDA/unit growth flywheel; operating leverage accretive to EBITDA per unit starting Q4 without GPU expansion. FCF generation viewed as underappreciated by market. Intraquarter data driving analyst confidence.
